comment: botl.c keeps a hit-point percentage in each of its two blstats banks, and bot() alternates between them, so a recomputed percentage is compared with the other bank's, which may be older than the last one computed; a pass that does not recompute it passes 0 to get_hilite(). With hitpoints/up/red/down/green, each of the jackal's bites keeps the 'down' rule.
